title: InvestmentLinkOutcome
description: Body of every /v1/investments/link and /v1/investments/sync response (ADR-044). HTTP status by status: LINKED 201 (POST link) or 200 (GET link), SYNCED 200, UNLINKED 200, NOT_LINKED 404, INVALID_INPUT 422 (field names the input; never its value), ACCESS_REJECTED 422 (the provider refused the email and password), READ_REFUSED 502 (the provider accepted the sign-in but refused to share the goals with that token; nothing is stored), RELINK_REQUIRED 409 (the provider no longer accepts the stored link: link again), CONFLICT 409 (the link changed during the request), PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE 503, READ_ONLY 403 (demo mode or a demo persona). link never carries the token, and the email only masked (first character and domain). A malformed body (not JSON, unknown or missing fields, a field of the wrong type) answers the AuthError of auth/error.schema.json, 422 with its field, like the other user-only writes.

email.description: Masked: the first character of the address and its domain.
